mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect a temperature of 67 degrees with overcast skies at Reddan Soccer Park. Under the Full Moon tonight, you can also catch a glimpse of the International Space Station at 4:11 AM as it moves from the direction of Cross Plains toward Madison near Home Depot for about three minutes.

The City of Verona has begun the eighteen-month process of updating its Comprehensive Plan to guide future growth and land use, with a final draft expected for review in September. Citizens are encouraged to visit the Envision Verona website to participate in the planning process.

There is plenty to do in Verona today, including the Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, yoga at Insight Wellness, and trivia at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus Brewing tomorrow, plus live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company this Thursday.
The Verona Police Department released their weekly recap, noting that officers responded to a motor vehicle crash this past Monday.
You can enjoy today's flavor of the day, which is Chocolate Caramel Twist, when the restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM.
